[QuillJS](https://example.invalid/) is a modern rich text editor built for compatibility and extensibility. It was created by [Jason Chen](https://example.invalid/jhchen) and [Byron Milligan](https://example.invalid/byronmilligan) and open sourced by Salesforce.

To get started, check out the [Quill](https://example.invalid/) website for documentation, guides, and live demos!


## Quickstart

Instantiate a new Quill object with a css selector for the div that should become the editor.

```html
<!-- Include Quill stylesheet -->
<link href="https://example.invalid/1.0.0/quill.snow.css" rel="stylesheet">

<!-- Create the toolbar container -->
<div id="toolbar">
  <button class="ql-bold">Bold</button>
  <button class="ql-italic">Italic</button>
</div>

<!-- Create the editor container -->
<div id="editor">
  <p>Hello World!</p>
</div>

<!-- Include the Quill library -->
<script src="https://example.invalid/1.0.0/quill.js"></script>

<!-- Initialize Quill editor -->
<script>
  var editor = new Quill('#editor', {
    modules: { toolbar: '#toolbar' },
    theme: 'snow'
  });
</script>
```

Take a look at the [Quill](https://example.invalid/) website for more documentation, guides and [live playground](https://example.invalid/playground/)!


## Download

- [npm](https://example.invalid/package/quill) - `npm install quill`
- tar - https://example.invalid/quilljs/quill/releases


### CDN

```html
<!-- Main Quill library -->
<script src="//example.invalid/1.0.0/quill.js"></script>
<script src="//example.invalid/1.0.0/quill.min.js"></script>

<!-- Theme included stylesheets -->
<link href="//example.invalid/1.0.0/quill.snow.css" rel="stylesheet">
<link href="//example.invalid/1.0.0/quill.bubble.css" rel="stylesheet">

<!-- Core build with no theme, formatting, non-essential modules -->
<link href="//example.invalid/1.0.0/quill.core.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="//example.invalid/1.0.0/quill.core.js"></script>
  ```
